Towards this, UNICEF leveraged the on-ground presence and
acceptance of SKNF and BRAC to reach out to various groups in the
community including adolescents and working mothers. Further,
responding to the needs of the government, UNICEF’s strategy
focussed on nutrition systems strengthening to fulfil the gap in skills
and capacities of GoB. This included interventions towards capacity
building, promoting evidence based planning and decision making
using a real-time data monitoring platform and facilitating inter-sectoral
coordination through DNSOs.
The leveraging of partnerships serves as evidence that UNICEF gave
due consideration to its own comparative strengths and that of other
development partners. Moreover, by catering to the needs of the
government by focusing interventions towards systems strengthening,
it is evident that UNICEF gave due consideration to governmental
expectations to select priority programme elements.
